Your cargo sails to a hub such as Dubai or Colombo and flies on from there, so it arrives in days rather than weeks, for much less than flying all the way. Ideal for landlocked countries and for shipments that can't wait for the ship but don't need the plane all the way.

Under the Project Imports Regulations, all the machinery, components and spares for an eligible project can be registered with Customs and cleared under heading {0} at a single rate of duty, instead of classifying each item separately.
